title: Pi Keymap Tweaks settings
description: Settings for Pi editor keybindings and thinking navigation.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors for this settings file.

continueLists.description: Start the next list item when inserting a newline on a numbered or bullet list line. A newline on an empty item ends the list.

undoEarlyCancel.description: Cancelling with the interrupt key before the response shows any output removes the prompt from the session and puts its text back in the editor.

cycleThinkingBackwardKey.description: Additional keybinding to cycle thinking backward (e.g. 'alt+shift+tab'). Ctrl+Alt+Left is always available.
